_doc: Named Colab runs for colab/dcad.py. data: dataset names (Drive: dcad/datasets/<name>.tar); train: extra train_smolvla.py args (added to defaults.train); probe: extra probe_grounding.py args (defaults: 32 layouts = n 96; 8 layouts gave 0.46 'grounding' for a 50-step model); eval_k: episodes/task for the final eval (0 = skip); init_from: continue another run's latest checkpoint (weights + optimizer). Add a new entry per experiment; never edit one that has run (its checkpoints on Drive were made with those args).
